0022600105.text: Cleveland, 0-1 and 11th in the East, hosts Brooklyn, which is also 0-1 and 10th in the East, so both teams are still searching for their first win of 2026-27. Tyler Bilodeau is out for the Nets with a shoulder injury, and the Cavaliers have no unavailable players. The teams have not met yet this season, but Cleveland won all three meetings in 2025-26 and beat Brooklyn 106-102 in Brooklyn on March 1, 2026.
